info.name: When I Work API Documentation Accounts Shifts API

params.name: user_id
params.description: The user id to filter by

params.name: start
params.description: The start of the filter range.

params.name: end
params.description: The end of the filter range.

params.name: unpublished
params.description: Whether or not to include unpublished shifts. Requires supervisor rights.

params.name: include_open
params.description: Whether or not to include open shifts from the user's assigned Schedules.

params.name: include_onlyopen
params.description: Whether or not to include only open shifts from the user's assigned Schedules.

params.name: include_allopen
params.description:
Whether or to include open shifts across All Schedules. Requires "Manager or Admin access" level.
Common practice is to combine allopen with one of the other inclusion options.

params.name: deleted
params.description: Whether to include a list of shift IDs ("deleted_ids") that were deleted during the passed time window.

params.name: include_swaps
params.description: Whether or not to include swap requests.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: all_locations
params.description:
Whether to include data from all locations. Shifts are marked as "readonly" if not a manager user.

If this option is included in addition to the `location_id` option, all shifts linked to other
locations, through users in other locations, will also be included.

params.name: location_id
params.description:
One or more location IDs by which to limit results

_Also see `all_locations` above_

params.name: shift_sort
params.description: True to sort results by user_id, false to sort by shift time. Missing for default sort

params.name: include_repeating_shifts_to
params.description: End date to include repeating shifts in series, if applicable

params.name: trim_openshifts
params.description: Setting to true will work w/ the Allow Partial Openshifts feature to display trimmed start/end times for users that can take a conflicting openshift based on the account settings.

params.name: limit_by_rules
params.description: Setting to true will work w/ the Scheduling Rules feature to only return OpenShifts that the requester is eligible for according to the scheduling rules settings for the account.

This history is a rolling 90 day period based on the shift start date/time. Also, history is not retained for OpenShifts following deletion of the shift.

params.name: start
params.description: The start range of the auto-schedule window

params.name: end
params.description: The end range of the auto-schedule window

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma separated list of openshift ids to include in auto schedule algorithm

params.name: location
params.description: The schedule (location) to include in auto schedule algorithm

params.name: autoScheduleMaxHours
params.description: The maximum hours any individual can be assigned per week, defaults to 40

params.name: autoScheduleUnavailability
params.description: Instruct algorithm to avoid unavailable preferences, defaults to true

params.name: autoSchedulePreferredTimes
params.description: Instruct algorithm to respect preferences, defaults to false

params.name: autoScheduleMultiShifts
params.description: Instruct algorithm to allow multiple shifts per day, defaults to false

params.name: autoScheduleMaxDailyHours
params.description: The maximum hours any individual can be assigned per day

params.name: seed
params.description: A randomization seed to get predictable assignment results

params.name: autoScheduleWeekendShifts
params.description: Instruct algorithm to prioritize weekend shifts (5pm Fri to 11:59pm Sun) during assignment, defaults to false

params.name: excludedUserIds
params.description: Comma separated list of user ids to exclude in auto schedule algorithm
